initialization_sites.behavior: zeroes storage, then copies the caller callback and allocator bindings; one allocator call
clears mutable execution state before four reset-vector reads; successful vectors set SR, PC, SSP, reset debt and ready flag; a callback fault leaves the instance terminal until reset
sets and clears active around execution; bounded event additions preflight overflow
updates host input and latches a rising level-7 edge

capture_rules: Capture requires a ready, idle, nonterminal instance and writes every record member by name.
Restore accepts an idle, nonterminal destination and validates a complete temporary named representation before the first CPU field assignment.
Restore performs no bus callbacks and retains destination-owned bus and allocator bindings.
The caller clones guest memory separately; the CPU record owns no memory buffer.
Fixed size/version checks require a valid accessible owned_cpu_state object; this is not an arbitrary-byte parser.
private_state_record.compatibility_limit: same compiled source build only; no public ABI, cross-build compatibility, durable snapshot, replay or save format is provided
private_state_record.core_identity: full SHA-256 of experiments/owned_cpu/cpu.c; format version is checked separately
excluded_or_reconstructed: ready is reconstructed to one only on successful restore
faulted and active are never stored and reject the operation when present on the relevant instance
no instruction prefetch/buffer state exists in this implementation
private_state_record.presence_mask: all sixteen field-group bits are required; missing groups reject before restore commit
private_state_record.record_kind: fixed-size, named-field, in-memory continuation record; fields are read and written individually, never serialized as raw struct bytes
supported_checkpoints: reset debt before its first run consumption
after each of the four original diagnostic instructions including STOP
pending level-7 edge after pin deassertion
canonical unsupported rejection (P01-C-14); six repeatable fresh-owner calls
RTE_odd_PC: ordinary RTE returns to an odd PC; capture/restore preserves it before deferred address error
SR_switch_odd_USP: supported SR transition selects an odd inactive USP; capture/restore preserves it before deferred fault behavior
validation: exact sizeof, version, full cpu.c SHA-256 identity, and required presence mask
boolean bytes and IRQ level range; odd PC or selected stack values are preserved for deferred execution faults
active A7 agrees with the S-selected USP or SSP
reset debt and event-cycle counters satisfy the implementation accounting invariant without overflow
private_state_record.visibility: owned_cpu_state and capture/restore declarations exist only under OWNED_CPU_TEST_HOOKS; they are absent from consumer builds

review_limitations: The checker recognizes the current conventional C source shape and explicit callback fixture names; it is a regression aid, not a C parser or proof of global completeness.
ThreadSanitizer evidence applies only when that instrumented configuration runs successfully on the current host. Separate-instance tests do not permit same-instance concurrent calls.
Plan 11 qualifies a private same-build in-memory continuation record only; it is not a public snapshot, cross-build compatibility, replay, durable save format, or memory snapshot.
